topics.definition: An entity is a real-world object or thing about which data is stored.
tips: Represented by a rectangle in an ER diagram.

topics.definition: Attributes describe the properties of an entity.
Attributes can be simple, composite, single-valued, multi-valued or derived.
tips: Multi-valued attributes use a double oval.

topics.definition: A relationship represents an association between two or more entities.
An entity set is a collection of similar entities.
tips: Contains entities of the same type.

topics.definition: Keys uniquely identify records in a database.
topics.syntax: Primary Key, Candidate Key, Foreign Key

topics.definition: Cardinality defines the number of entities participating in a relationship.
Participation specifies whether participation is total or partial.
topics.example: Every Employee belongs to a Department
tips: Shown using single or double lines.

topics.definition: An ER diagram graphically represents entities, attributes and relationships.
